questions.question: What is the compound interest on Rs. 8400 for 2 years at 10% per annum compounded annually?
questions.solution:

Principal amount(P) = 8400 

Time = 2 year 

Rate % = 10%

**Formula used:- **

Compound Interest = P ( 1 + R/100 )T - P

where T = time and P = principal R = Rate of interest 

**Calculation:- **

Compound Interest = 8400 ( 1 + 10/100)² - 8400 

⇒ 8400 (110/100)² - 8400 

⇒ 10164 - 8400 = 1764** 

 ∴ The required answer is__ 1764__.

questions.question: 14 workers working 16 hours per day can demolish a building in 81 days. In how many days 18 workers working 24 hours per day can demolish the same building?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct MDH formula: M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂

⇒ 14 × 81 × 16 = 18 × D₂ × 24

⇒ D₂ = (14 × 81 × 16) ÷ (18 × 24)

⇒ D₂ = 18144 ÷ 432

⇒ D₂ = 42 days

**∴ The correct answer is 42 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Workers in first group (M₁) = 14

Days taken (D₁) = 81

Hours per day (H₁) = 16

Workers in second group (M₂) = 18

Hours per day (H₂) = 24

**Formula Used:**

Since the building to be demolished is the same, the total work is constant (W₁ = W₂).

MDH Rule: M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂

 
 Group 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ 14 × 81 × 16 = 18 × D₂ × 24

⇒ D₂ = (14 × 81 × 16) ÷ (18 × 24)

Simplifying the ratios step-by-step:

⇒ D₂ = 14 × (81 ÷ 18) × (16 ÷ 24)

⇒ D₂ = 14 × (9 ÷ 2) × (2 ÷ 3)

Canceling out the common factor of 2:

⇒ D₂ = 14 × (9 ÷ 3)

⇒ D₂ = 14 × 3

⇒ D₂ = 42 days

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

The rule states that if M₁ persons can do W₁ work in D₁ days working H₁ hours a day, and M₂ persons can do W₂ work in D₂ days working H₂ hours a day, then (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

Work Equivalence Principle

When two groups perform the exact same task, the total effort measured in man-hours or man-days remains constant. Thus, Total Work = Men × Days × Hours.

Direct and Inverse Proportions

More work requires more workers (direct proportion, M ∝ W). More workers require fewer days to complete the same work (inverse proportion, M ∝ 1 ÷ D).

questions.question: A car left 4 hours later than the scheduled time but in order to reach its destination 480 km away in time, it had to increase its usual speed by 10 km/hr. What is the usual speed of the car?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Let the usual speed of the car be ‘x’ km/hr.

Time is taken to cover 480 km = Distance/Speed = 480/x hrs.

But, when the car left 4 hours left, the Speed of the car = (x + 10) km/hr.

⇒ Time taken = Distance/Speed = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480/x) - 4 = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480- 4x)/x = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480 - 4x)(x + 10) = 480x

⇒ 480x + 4800 - 4x² - 40x = 480x

 

⇒ 4x² + 40x - 4800 = 0 

⇒ x² + 10x - 1200 = 0 

⇒ x2 + 40x - 30x - 1200 = 0

⇒ x(x + 40) - 30(x + 40) = 0

⇒ (x + 40)(x - 30) = 0

⇒ x = -40, 30 

∵ Speed cannot be negative 

**∴ The required answer is __30__. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Distance = (X × Y)/(X - Y) [time difference]

⇒ [x × (x + 10)/10] × 4 = 480

⇒ x(x + 10) = 1200

⇒ x × (x + 10) = 30 × 40

⇒ x = 30 km/hr

questions.question: What is the Highest Common Factor of 25, 15 and 75?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Find the minimum difference between any two given numbers: 25 − 15 = 10.

The HCF must be a factor of this difference (factors of 10 are 1, 2, 5, 10).

Check the highest factor 10: it does not divide 15.

Check the next highest factor 5: it exactly divides 25, 15, and 75.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 25, 15, and 75.

**Formula Used:**

HCF is the product of the lowest powers of all common prime factors.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 25 = 5 × 5 = 5²

⇒ Prime factorization of 75 = 3 × 5 × 5 = 3 × 5²

⇒ The only common prime factor among all three numbers is 5.

⇒ The lowest power of 5 present in all factorizations is 5¹.

⇒ Highest Common Factor (HCF) = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest multiple that is common to two or more numbers. It is found by multiplying the highest powers of all prime factors.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is 1. They do not need to be prime numbers individually (e.g., 8 and 15).

Product of Two Numbers Rule

For any two given numbers a and b: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b). This relationship applies strictly to two numbers only.
</p

questions.question: Average of 8 numbers is 44. The average of first three numbers is 50 and the average of next two numbers is 52. If the sixth number is 6 and 8 less than seventh and eighth number respectively, then what is the value of eighth number?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of 8 numbers = 8 × 44 = 352.

Sum of first five numbers = (3 × 50) + (2 × 52) = 150 + 104 = 254.

Sum of last three numbers (6th, 7th, and 8th) = 352 − 254 = 98.

As 6th is 6 and 8 less than 7th and 8th: 3 × (6th number) + 6 + 8 = 98.

6th number = (98 − 14) ÷ 3 = 28.

8th number = 28 + 8 = 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 8 numbers = 44

Average of first 3 numbers = 50

Average of next 2 numbers = 52

6th number = 7th number − 6 = 8th number − 8

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of terms

 
 
• 
 
• 
 First 3 (Avg: 50)
 Next 2 (Avg: 52)
 Last 3 (Sum: 98)
 Total Average = 44 (Sum = 352)
 

 6th: x
 7th: x+6
 8th: x+8

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of all 8 numbers = 8 × 44 = 352

⇒ Sum of first 3 numbers = 3 × 50 = 150

⇒ Sum of next 2 numbers = 2 × 52 = 104

⇒ Sum of 6th, 7th, and 8th numbers = 352 − (150 + 104) = 98

⇒ Let the 6th number be x.

⇒ 7th number = x + 6

⇒ 8th number = x + 8

⇒ x + (x + 6) + (x + 8) = 98

⇒ 3x + 14 = 98

⇒ 3x = 98 − 14 = 84

⇒ x = 28

⇒ 8th number = 28 + 8 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Weighted Average

When groups have different averages: Combined Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

Sum of Deviations

The algebraic sum of deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero.</p

• **Comets:-**

 
 
• These are **cosmic snowballs** of **frozen gases, rock, and dust** that orbit the Sun.
 
• They have a **coma**, a fuzzy atmosphere of gas and dust that surrounds the nucleus, and a **tail** that points away from the Sun.
 
• Comets are believed to be remnants from the **formation of the Solar System.**
 
• They can have** highly elliptical orbits **and can take hundreds or thousands of years to complete one orbit around the Sun.

• **Meteors:-**

 
 
• These are small rocks or debris that** burn up** upon entering Earth's atmosphere, while **meteorites **are any **surviving pieces** that reach the ground.
 
 
 
• **Stars:-**
 
 
• These are massive, luminous spheres of **plasma** held together by **gravity.**
 
 
 
• **Meteorites**:-
 
 
• These are pieces of rock or metal that have fallen to Earth from space.
 
• They are the only physical evidence we have of what exists beyond our planet, and they can provide valuable insights into the formation and evolution of the solar system.
